title: Schrödinger Bridge Over A Compact Connected Lie Group
summary: This work studies the Schrödinger bridge problem for the kinematic equation on a compact connected Lie group. The objective is to steer a controlled diffusion between given initial and terminal densities supported over the Lie group while minimizing the control effort. We develop a coordinate-free formulation of this stochastic optimal control problem that respects the underlying geometric structure of the Lie group, thereby avoiding limitations associated with local parameterizations or embeddings in Euclidean spaces.
